verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Teams can provision Team Computers, assign them to members or groups, and provision access through an admin panel or SSO. None of it documents unattended access, where a connection with pre-configured credentials skips host-side approval. Provisioning and assignment are adjacent access-management features and do not show that nobody needs to be present at the host to accept.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can set up unattended access to a machine with credentials configured in advance, so no one has to sit at the host to accept
